en.description: Activation cues are scattered: prominent occurrences of the strings Cor/cor and newline markers, alongside various numbers, subword fragments, and formatting symbols. These triggers are interleaved across corpora, with no reliable unified semantics.

patterns.name: Cor/cor strings
patterns.context: Case-insensitive Cor prefix appearing inside words or in field names; subsequent characters vary.
patterns.domain: PubMed author affiliations, corporate email signatures, StackExchange configuration text

patterns.name: ↵ newline marker
patterns.context: The newline marker itself repeatedly activates, often between questions, list items, or paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Math problems, email, HackerNews text, and formatted content

patterns.name: Numbers or numeric fragments
patterns.context: Number strings or numeric substrings, with no stable numerical semantics; especially dense in math problems.
patterns.domain: Math problems and other mixed text

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments and delimiters
patterns.context: Word fragments at token boundaries, along with punctuation or formatting fragments; no consistent semantics across passages.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, web, patent, and other corpora

10_1661.description: 激活线索分散：突出出现 Cor/cor 字符串及换行标记，另有多种数字、词片段和格式符号；这些触发在不同语料中交错，尚无可靠统一语义。

patterns.name: Cor／cor 字符串
patterns.context: 大小写不敏感的 Cor 前缀，出现在单词内部或字段名中；后续字符各异。
patterns.domain: PubMed署名、企业邮件签名、StackExchange配置文本

patterns.name: ↵ 换行标记
patterns.context: 换行标记本身反复激活，常处于题目、列表或段落之间。
patterns.domain: 数学题、邮件、HackerNews文本及格式化内容

patterns.name: 数字或数字片段
patterns.context: 数字串或数字子串，未见稳定的数值语义；数学题中尤为密集。
patterns.domain: 数学题及其他混合文本

patterns.name: 零散词片段及分隔符
patterns.trigger: «LR»、« receptor»、« complex»、«ded»、«u»、« overlay»、« AGE»、« nec»、« Field»、« anthrop»
patterns.context: 分词边界上的词片段，以及标点或格式片段；跨段缺乏一致语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、网页文本、专利及其他语料

en.description: Activations are distributed across different corpora. The more stable surface cue is the «Cor» fragment within words; newline and number fragments also activate in math problems. Other trigger words are scattered across web, biomedical, patent, and configuration text, with no shared context.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments beginning with Cor-
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs at the beginning of English words that respectively refer to a corresponding author, an institution name, a surname, and a technical field; there is no unified semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical author affiliations, business email, ergonomics citations, software configuration

patterns.name: Number and math-problem formatting
patterns.context: Occurs near line breaks in arithmetic exercises, problems, and answers; activations fall on line breaks, number fragments, or numeric formats, with no consistent operator or number category evident.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments and technical terms
patterns.context: Falls within words or fragments such as zded, PBMCs, necrotic, polishing, and anthropometries; no shared local syntactic or semantic condition is evident across occurrences.
patterns.domain: Web headlines, biomedical abstracts and papers, patents, ergonomics text

patterns.name: Other sporadic markers
patterns.context: Occurs in number problems, problem instructions, and JSON/configuration fields; these sporadic trigger points do not establish a shared condition.

10_1661.description: 激活分散于不同语料。较稳定的表面线索是词内 «Cor» 片段；数学题中也出现换行与数字片段激活。其余触发词分散在网页、生医、专利及配置文本，缺乏共同上下文。

patterns.name: Cor- 开头的词内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段处于英文单词开头；词分别表示通讯作者、机构名称、姓氏和技术字段，没有统一语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学署名、商务邮件、人体工程学引文、软件配置

patterns.name: 数字及数学题排版
patterns.trigger: 换行标记 «↵»3，以及数字或算术文本中的 «778»、«119»、«40» 等
patterns.context: 出现在分行的算术练习、题目和答案附近；其中激活落在换行、数字片段或数值格式内部，未显现统一的运算符或数值类别。

patterns.name: 特定词片段与技术术语
patterns.context: 分别落在 zded、PBMCs、necrotic、polishing、anthropometries 等词或词片段中；各处未显示共同的局部句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、生物医学摘要与论文、专利、人体工程学文本

patterns.name: 其他零散标记
patterns.context: 分别出现在数字题目、题目指令和 JSON/配置字段中；无法从这些零散触发点确立共享条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across newline markers, numbers and equation fragments in math problems, and terms and citation markers in biomedical text; forum headline fragments also occur. There is no single stable semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Newline markers
patterns.context: Indicates a text line break and appears in places such as headlines, math problems, or the start of abstract paragraphs; it does not depend on specific semantic content.

patterns.name: Numbers and equations in math problems
patterns.context: Numbers, punctuation, and equation fragments occur densely, often in math questions and answers or calculation steps listed one by one; activations fall on several number fragments.

patterns.name: Number fragments in numeric sequences
patterns.context: Short numbers or alphanumeric fragments after tokenization; some occur near headlines or links without obvious arithmetic semantics, while others are embedded in numbers in math problems.
patterns.domain: Forum headlines, math text, and general text

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: In medical or biological abstracts, activations occur on terms, abbreviations, or substrings within words; meanings and topics differ across paragraphs.

patterns.name: Citation numbers and reference markers
patterns.context: Embedded reference numbers, citation labels, or reference locators in paper text.

patterns.name: Short function words and symbol fragments
patterns.context: Occasionally activates in medical abstracts or math text, without a stable lexical meaning or unified syntactic condition.

patterns.name: HackerNews headline and link fragments
patterns.context: In short headlines and the following link strings, activations fall on headline words, alphanumeric fragments, and newline markers; a more specific trigger condition cannot be determined from a single passage.

patterns.name: Protein receptor-related terms
patterns.context: In abstracts discussing receptor domains, ligand sensing, and complex formation, activations sporadically fall on terms and fragments of author names.

patterns.name: Phospholipid and nuclear magnetic resonance terms
patterns.context: In sentences describing phospholipid vesicles, choline headgroups, and nuclear magnetic resonance spectra, activations occur on substrings of chemical terms.

10_1661.concept: 文本片段边界与局部模式
10_1661.description: 激活分布在换行标记、数学题的数字与算式片段，以及生物医学文本中的术语和引用标记；另见论坛标题碎片。没有单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 表示文本换行，在标题、数学题目或摘要段落开头等位置出现；不依赖特定语义内容。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与算式
patterns.context: 数字、标点和算式片段密集出现，常处于逐题列出的数学问答或计算过程；激活落在若干数字片段上。

patterns.name: 数值序列中的数字片段
patterns.context: token 切分后的短数字或字母数字片段；部分位于无明显算术语义的标题、链接附近，部分嵌在数学题的数字中。
patterns.domain: 论坛标题、数学文本及一般文本

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 医学或生物学摘要中，激活出现在术语、缩写或词内子串上；不同段落中的词义和主题不完全相同。

patterns.name: 引用编号与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中嵌入的文献编号、引用标签或参考文献定位符。

patterns.name: 短促功能词和符号片段
patterns.context: 在医学摘要或数学文字中偶发激活，未呈现稳定的词义或统一句法条件。

patterns.name: HackerNews 标题与链接碎片
patterns.context: 短标题及其后续链接字符串中，激活落在标题词、字母数字碎片和换行标记上；无法从单段确定更具体的触发条件。

patterns.name: 蛋白受体相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论受体结构域、配体感知和复合物形成的摘要文字中，激活零散落在术语及作者姓名片段上。

patterns.name: 磷脂与核磁共振术语
patterns.context: 描述磷脂囊泡、胆碱头基和核磁共振谱的句子中，激活出现在化学术语的子串上。

en.description: Activation is scattered across medical terminology, concern, mathematical symbols, heading typography, and several intra-word fragments. Newlines and formatting markers also occur repeatedly, but the triggering conditions are unstable and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Local fragments at word endings or in markers
patterns.context: Highlights appear within words or at word boundaries, possibly related to subword segmentation or spelling fragments; these examples are insufficient to establish a unified lexical condition

patterns.name: Medical terminology and specialist abbreviations
patterns.context: Occurs in medical papers or case descriptions involving diseases, blood vessels, treatments, or medical abbreviations; the specific marked fragments vary

patterns.name: concern and its discourse context
patterns.context: Occurs in formal discussion, expressing concern about research or public health issues; “major” appears nearby in both instances, but several words apart

patterns.name: Numerical values and operation structures in math problems
patterns.context: Occurs in algebra problems asking for a ones digit and in subsequent problems; no stable, distinctive mathematical trigger substring is evident

patterns.name: Patient story heading layout
patterns.context: Webpage headings and section text are separated by newlines, with descriptions of patients and family members; activation also falls on headings or layout fragments

patterns.name: Word fragments in anti-Islamophobia discourse
patterns.context: Occurs in quotations or comments on the claim that “fearing Islam is reasonable”; there is no evidence that the topic itself is a stable trigger condition

patterns.name: Paragraph and section formatting markers
patterns.context: Appears at paragraph starts, blank lines, or section separators; may co-occur with medical introductions or math Q&A content, so it does not establish an independent pattern

10_1661.description: 激活分散在医学术语、concern、数学符号、标题排版及若干词内片段；换行和格式标记也多次出现，但触发条件不稳定，无法用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 词尾或标记中的局部片段
patterns.context: 高亮呈现在词内或词边界，可能与子词切分、拼写片段有关；这些实例不足以确认统一词法条件
patterns.domain: 网页文本、姓名、一般英文

patterns.name: 医学术语与专业缩写
patterns.context: 出现在医学论文或病例描述中，涉及疾病、血管、治疗或医学缩写；其中被标记的具体片段并不一致

patterns.name: concern 及其论述语境
patterns.context: 位于正式论述中，表达研究或公共卫生议题的关注；两处附近都出现「major」，但中间相隔多词

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与运算结构
patterns.context: 出现在要求求个位数的代数题及其后续题目中；未见稳定、专属的数学触发子串

patterns.name: 患者故事标题排版
patterns.context: 网页标题与栏目文字由换行分隔，夹杂患者、家属相关介绍；激活也落在标题或排版片段上

patterns.name: 反伊斯兰恐惧论述中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在对“害怕伊斯兰是合理的”这一主张的引述或评论中；暂无证据表明该主题本身是稳定触发条件

patterns.name: 段落与章节格式标记
patterns.context: 作为段落开头、空行或章节分隔符出现；可与医学引言或数学问答内容同时出现，不能据此确认独立模式

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-initial and word-internal fragments, alphanumeric abbreviations and adjacent tokens; they also commonly occur in hyphenated compounds and at newline layout boundaries. The examples lack a stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word-initial or word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on the beginning or first few subword fragments of complete words, which then continue into multisyllabic words; meanings and syntax are not fixed.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Letters, numbers, punctuation, and subword fragments occur adjacent to one another in code identifiers, legal citations, or technical abbreviations.

patterns.name: Common token continuations in phrases
patterns.context: Common words or phrases are split into multiple tokens, with activations distributed across within-word fragments and nearby tokens; there is no fixed semantic meaning or sentence structure.
patterns.domain: News-style copy, email, and general text

patterns.name: Newlines and layout boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur at line breaks between paragraphs, headlines, or page sections; sometimes they are adjacent to proper nouns or section content.

patterns.name: Hyphens within compounds
patterns.context: When a hyphen joins words or forms a term, fragments on either side of the hyphen may activate.
patterns.domain: Marketing copy, medical and immunology text

10_1661.description: 激活分散在词首/词内片段、字母数字缩写及其相邻 token，也常见于连字符复合词和换行版面边界；各例缺乏稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 词首或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整单词的开头或前几个子词片段，随后继续拼成多音节词；词义和句法并不固定。

patterns.name: 缩写与字母数字串
patterns.context: 代码标识符、法律引证或专业缩写中，字母、数字、标点及子词片段相邻。

patterns.name: 短语中的常见分词延续
patterns.context: 常见词或短语被拆成多个 token，激活分布在词内片段及其附近；并非固定语义或固定句式。
patterns.domain: 新闻式文案、邮件及一般文本

patterns.name: 换行与版面边界
patterns.context: 段落、标题或页面模块之间的换行处激活；有时紧邻专名或栏目内容。

patterns.name: 复合词内部的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接词语或构成术语时，连字符两侧的片段均可能激活。
patterns.domain: 营销文案、医学及免疫学文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematical symbols and numbers, medical and notification text, code and JSON fields, character configurations, and commentary on social issues. Apart from local word forms or formatting, there is no stable cross-passage trigger condition.

patterns.name: Logical symbols after “neg”
patterns.context: In formal logic or set-theory expressions, symbols occur within LaTeX mathematical notation or its transcription; they are sometimes adjacent to variables and parentheses.

patterns.name: Numbers and radicals in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on expression tokens containing numbers, radical signs, and operators; no common specific formula structure is apparent.

patterns.name: Otorhinological terminology fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “ear surgery,” in a sentence about ear surgery and Ménière’s disease; the trigger is limited to one word fragment.

patterns.name: Email subject or course notification field
patterns.context: Occurs in the “Harassment Avoidance” heading after a newline; the preceding text is a course registration notice.

patterns.name: JSON keys, values, and identifiers
patterns.context: In JSON-style objects, activation is distributed across keys, string values, and numbers; JSON record fields also trigger.

patterns.name: Go code import statement
patterns.context: Package declaration and import block in Go source code, containing a MongoDB driver path.

patterns.name: Game character configuration fields
patterns.context: JSON-style character data containing character descriptions, name suffixes, and category fields.

patterns.name: Controversial social issue vocabulary
patterns.context: In a comment on whether fear of Islam is reasonable, activation is distributed across issue-related and evaluative words.

10_1661.description: 激活分散在数学符号与数字、医学和通知文本、代码及JSON字段、角色配置和社会议题评论中；除局部词形或格式外，看不出跨段稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: “neg”后的逻辑符号
patterns.context: 形式逻辑或集合论表达式中，符号处于 LaTeX 数学记号或其转写形式内；有时邻接变量和括号。

patterns.name: 数学式中的数字与根式
patterns.context: 激活落在含数字、根号和运算符的算式 token 上；没有明显共同的具体公式结构。

patterns.name: 耳科术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在“ear surgery”短语中，句子谈及耳科手术与梅尼埃病；触发仅限一个词片段。

patterns.name: 邮件标题或课程通知字段
patterns.context: 出现在换行后的“Harassment Avoidance”标题中，前文是课程注册通知。

patterns.name: JSON 键值与标识符
patterns.context: JSON 风格对象中，激活分布于键名、字符串值和数字；另有 JSON 记录字段触发。
patterns.domain: Github 数据文件/结构化文本

patterns.name: Go 代码导入语句
patterns.context: Go 源码的包声明与 import 块，含 MongoDB 驱动路径。

patterns.name: 游戏角色配置字段
patterns.context: JSON 风格角色数据中，包含角色说明、名称后缀和类别字段。
patterns.domain: Github 游戏/角色配置数据

patterns.name: 争议性社会议题词汇
patterns.context: 在表达对伊斯兰恐惧是否合理的评论句中，激活分布于议题词与评价性词语。

en.concept: Text structure boundaries, with a preference for newlines
en.description: The most prominent common feature across passages is newlines and layout boundaries. Activation occurs in mathematical text, code, legal documents, and email; formula structures, code statements, and document fields show weaker activation as well.

patterns.name: Newline after line endings or formula environments
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on newline tokens, often after mathematical typesetting, code, or document paragraph boundaries; the first passage also contains formatting cues such as «/»5.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and LaTeX structures
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols, formula markers, LaTeX environments, and surrounding newlines; activation is also distributed across variables, punctuation, and structural tokens.

patterns.name: Code lines and statement boundaries
patterns.context: Near statements, indentation, and closing parentheses in code snippets, especially where code ends and ordinary text begins.

patterns.name: Legal document formatting and headers
patterns.context: Layout regions such as headings, dates, disclaimers, and signatures in court opinions.

patterns.name: Email headers and body layout
patterns.context: Email header fields, recipient information, or signature areas at the end of the body; strong activation is primarily on newlines.

10_1661.concept: 文本结构边界，偏好换行
10_1661.description: 各段最突出的共同点是换行及版式边界；数学文本、代码、法律文书和邮件中均有激活，公式结构、代码语句与文档字段也出现较弱激活。

patterns.name: 行尾或公式环境后的换行
patterns.context: 显著激活落在换行 token 上，常出现在数学排版、代码或文档段落边界之后；第1段还有「«/»5」等格式线索。

patterns.name: 数学公式与 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式标记、LaTeX 环境及其周边换行；激活也分布在变量、标点和结构 token 上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、数学问答

patterns.name: 代码行与语句边界
patterns.context: 代码片段中的语句、缩进和闭合括号附近，尤其是代码结束后转入普通文字处。

patterns.name: 法律文档格式与页眉
patterns.context: 法院意见文本的标题、日期、免责声明和署名等版式区域。

patterns.name: 邮件头与邮件正文版式
patterns.context: 邮件头字段、收件人信息或正文末尾的签名区域，显著激活主要在换行。

en.description: All passages are code or code-adjacent text from technical Q&A. Activation is distributed around newlines and indentation, punctuation boundaries, identifiers, and property names. It spans frontend development, file handling, configuration, and multiple languages, with no single topic word or language dominating.

patterns.name: Code syntax and structural symbols
patterns.context: Activation occurs at newlines or indentation and punctuation boundaries in code snippets; it is not limited to one language, and some activation is adjacent to code tokens
patterns.domain: Multilingual code, configuration, and markup languages

patterns.name: Names and property boundaries in code
patterns.context: Near code identifiers, property names, or member-access expressions; often involving camelCase or compound names, but not a consistent specific name
patterns.domain: Source code in software development Q&A

patterns.name: JavaScript/React code and browser operations
patterns.context: Imports, UI components, browser detection, or scrolling code in frontend examples
patterns.domain: JavaScript, React, jQuery, and browser development

patterns.name: File, data, and serialization operations
patterns.context: Contexts where code reads, writes, iterates over, or processes files and data fields
patterns.domain: Node.js, PHP, Python, and data-processing code

patterns.name: Property, layout, and namespace configuration in code
patterns.context: Attributes or configuration key-value pairs describing component bindings, layout resources, or autoloading rules
patterns.domain: XAML/XML, Android, and PHP Composer configuration

patterns.name: Conditional logic and callback expressions
patterns.context: Near conditional branches, callbacks, or anonymous functions inside function bodies; reflects program control flow
patterns.domain: Example code in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Natural-language comments/explanations in code examples
patterns.context: Comments or introductory explanations near code; specific content varies

patterns.name: Scattered HTML/template text
patterns.context: HTML fragments or template-rendering calls embedded in source code, including ordinary text fields

patterns.name: Python line-by-line file processing
patterns.context: Code that reads a text file and counts or compares values line by line

patterns.name: Idiomatic browser-detection expression
patterns.context: A JavaScript technique for browser identification using a function-string form

10_1661.description: 所有片段均为技术问答中的代码或代码邻近文本，激活分布在换行缩进、标点边界、标识符及属性名附近；涵盖前端、文件处理、配置和多种语言，未见单一主题词或语言主导。

patterns.name: 代码语法与结构符号
patterns.context: 在代码片段中，换行或缩进以及标点边界处激活；不局限于某一种语言，部分激活紧邻代码 token
patterns.domain: 多语言编程代码、配置与标记语言

patterns.name: 代码中的名称与属性边界
patterns.context: 代码标识符、属性名或成员访问表达式附近；常见于驼峰式或复合名称，但并非统一的具体名称
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答中的源代码

patterns.name: JavaScript/React 代码与浏览器操作
patterns.context: 前端示例中的导入、UI 组件、浏览器检测或滚动处理代码

patterns.name: 文件、数据与序列化操作
patterns.context: 代码读写、遍历或处理文件、数据字段的上下文

en.description: Activation occurs primarily around indentation, newlines, and structural boundaries in code and markup languages, spanning JSX, HTML, Ruby, and PHP snippets. patterns.name: Table rows, columns, and numeric formatting

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and their formatting

patterns.name: 表格行列与数值排版

patterns.name: Time intervals and clinical narratives in medicine

patterns.name: String fragments in proper nouns

patterns.name: 英文日期、时间和数字标记

patterns.name: Medical mass complication terminology

patterns.name: Spinal devices and puncture techniques
