patterns.name: Breast tumor case description
patterns.context: Describes breast cancer, refusal of biopsy, mastectomy, and characteristics of a mass in the specimen.

10_1661.description: 激活分布于数量和时间表达、身体部位及损伤或医疗操作、法律程序与事件顺序，也包括足球判罚、星系吸积加热和乳腺病例；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 明确数量或时间尺度
patterns.context: 数字或数量词附近，尤其是时间间隔、病例数、规模或尺寸的叙述中；触发位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙述、天体物理、法律、医学、社会科学

patterns.name: 身体部位与损伤／医疗操作
patterns.context: 描述身体部位、创伤、手术或医学检查时，常伴随具体动作、解剖位置或临床结果。
patterns.domain: 法律事实陈述、专利医疗技术、医学摘要与病例报告

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁判记录
patterns.context: 法律文书叙述诉讼程序、上诉审查或案卷记录时；有时激活落在程序词或一般法律措辞上。

patterns.name: 足球比赛判罚与进球事件
patterns.context: 足球比赛报道中，裁判判罚、进球被判无效及后续换人构成连续事件。

patterns.name: 星系并合中的物质吸积与加热
patterns.context: 描述星系并合期间气体进入系统及随后的再加热过程。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的时间顺序与日期
patterns.context: 按日期和间隔交代请愿、送达或其他法律事件的先后顺序。

patterns.name: 程序动作与过程性动词
patterns.context: 描述穿透、侵犯、抓取或投掷等对对象产生影响的动作；语义和领域不统一。
patterns.domain: 医学／专利文本及法律事实叙述

patterns.name: 数量统计与比例报告
patterns.context: 报告病例数、比例或群体数量，数字常与统计性名词或单位相邻。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、社会科学研究

patterns.name: 乳腺肿瘤病例描述
patterns.context: 描述乳腺癌、拒绝活检、接受乳房切除及标本中的肿块特征。

en.description: Activations are distributed across temporal expressions (same day, later, short timescales, every six months), specific clinical measurements, and event details. Multiple passages emphasize intervals or event order, but isolated patterns also include size, limb restraint, and violent narratives.

patterns.name: On the same day
patterns.context: The temporal adverbial phrase “on the same day,” especially when recounting event timing at the beginning of a sentence; activation is strong near “same/day,” with variable capitalization.

patterns.name: Subsequent events after a time interval
patterns.context: Marks an immediately following event by a time interval; strong responses fall on time units or interval words.

patterns.name: Short timescales
patterns.context: Describes a process occurring on a short timescale, with strong responses to short-duration phrases.

patterns.name: Size unit cm
patterns.context: Reports mass size in centimeters during medical examination; the unit cm activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Head impaled on a pike
patterns.context: Describes the specific detail of a head being impaled on a pike after a violent event; the response is concentrated near on a pike.

patterns.name: Arm restraint
patterns.context: Describes one of a victim’s arms being raised and the other being held, preventing them from breaking a fall; “arm” activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Every six months
patterns.context: Specifies an interval for routine follow-up or treatment, emphasizing once every six months.

patterns.name: Postoperative excision description
patterns.context: After surgical excision, describes tumor-bed markers and tissue sampling; local activations fall on sentence-initial/determiner words such as After and A, without a stable shared trigger word.

10_1661.description: 激活分布于时间表达（同日、稍后、短时程、每六个月）、具体临床测量及事件细节；多个段落突出时间间隔或事件先后，但也有尺寸、肢体受制和暴力叙述等孤立模式。

patterns.name: On the same day
patterns.context: 时间状语短语“在同一天”，尤其句首转述事件时间；“same/day”附近激活强，大小写不一。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后续事件
patterns.context: 以一段时间间隔标记紧接发生的后续事件；强响应落在时间单位或间隔词上。

patterns.name: 短时间尺度
patterns.context: 描述过程在短时间尺度内发生，短时程词组受到突出响应。

patterns.name: 尺寸单位 cm
patterns.context: 医学检查中以厘米报告肿块尺寸，单位 cm 激活最强。

patterns.name: 头部插在尖桩上
patterns.context: 叙述暴力事件后将头颅插在尖桩上的具体情节，响应集中在 on a pike 附近。

patterns.name: 手臂受制
patterns.context: 描述受害者一只手臂被抬起、另一只被抓住，因而无法支撑跌倒；“arm”最强。

patterns.name: 每六个月
patterns.context: 规定定期复诊或治疗的时间间隔，强调每六个月一次。

patterns.name: 术后切除描述
patterns.context: 手术切除后描述肿瘤床标记及取材；局部激活落在 After、A 等句首／名词引导词，未见稳定共同触发词。

en.description: Activations appear around medical measurements and masses, surgery, orthopedics, and cardiac lesions, as well as dentistry, bytes or numeric checks in code, and legal descriptions of injuries; no clear common trigger.

patterns.name: Measurement unit cm
patterns.context: Appears after a number or range to describe size, boundaries, or distance
patterns.domain: Measurements in medical papers, such as masses and radiotherapy margins

patterns.name: Numeric and decimal measurements
patterns.context: Numbers, decimal points, multiplication signs, or ranges appear alongside medical measurements

patterns.name: Medical masses and lesions
patterns.context: Refers to masses, metastases, or lesions in body tissue, often near information on location, size, examination, or treatment

patterns.name: Surgery and tissue handling
patterns.context: Describes surgery, excision, or intraoperative findings

patterns.name: Orthopedic complications and implants
patterns.context: Follow-up statistics on surgery-related fractures, prosthetic stem perforation, and bone ingrowth

patterns.name: Cardiac thrombus and embolism
patterns.context: Links renal infarction to a left ventricular thrombus source

patterns.name: Dental caries events
patterns.context: Defines caries, filling, or extraction on a tooth surface that was healthy at baseline

patterns.name: Buffer bytes and code
patterns.context: Discusses the state of the fifth byte in a buffer when too few bytes are read

patterns.name: Limb injury narrative
patterns.context: Describes being grabbed, falling, and sustaining bruises
patterns.domain: Legal statements of fact or testimony

patterns.name: JavaScript validation prompt
patterns.context: A code branch displays a prompt that the input must be numeric and returns

10_1661.description: 激活分布于医学尺寸与肿块、手术、骨科及心脏病灶，也见牙科、代码中的字节或数字校验，以及法律伤情叙述；共同触发因素不明确。

patterns.name: 计量单位 cm
patterns.context: 数字或范围后出现，描述尺寸、边界或距离
patterns.domain: 医学论文中的肿块、放疗边界等测量

patterns.name: 数值与小数尺寸
patterns.context: 数字、小数点、乘号或范围与医学测量并列

patterns.name: 医学肿块与病灶
patterns.context: 指人体组织中的肿块、转移灶或病变，常与位置、大小、检查或治疗相邻

patterns.name: 手术及组织处理
patterns.context: 描述手术、切除或术中发现

patterns.name: 骨科并发症与植入物
patterns.context: 随访统计手术相关骨折、假体柄穿孔及骨长入

patterns.name: 心脏血栓及栓塞
patterns.context: 将肾梗死与左心室血栓来源联系起来

patterns.name: 牙科龋病事件
patterns.context: 定义基线原本健康的牙面出现龋损、充填或拔除

patterns.name: 缓冲区字节与代码
patterns.context: 讨论读取字节数不足时缓冲区第五字节的状态

patterns.name: 肢体受伤叙述
patterns.context: 描述被抓、摔倒及身体出现瘀伤

patterns.name: JavaScript 校验提示
patterns.context: 代码分支中弹出输入值必须为数字的提示并返回

en.description: Activations span mathematical formulas, sports reporting, and medical text; medical passages often involve follow-up or disease-course timing, event definitions, cases, and study results, but no single word or domain covers all fragments.

patterns.name: Delay and follow-up duration in medical papers
patterns.context: In medical cases or clinical studies, describes follow-up or the time from treatment or implantation to an event, often with numbers, units, and temporal relations

patterns.name: Iteration subscripts and counts in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Formulas contain subscripted iteration variables and integer sequences representing the number of iterations

patterns.name: Time variables and intervals in evolution equations
patterns.context: Abstract evolution equations use the time variable t to represent changes in state and restrict it to a given interval

patterns.name: Chronological progression of match events
patterns.context: Sports match reports describe decisions, goals, and player substitutions in sequence, using elapsed minutes to connect them

patterns.name: Event dates and investigation timelines
patterns.context: Recounts when investigation- or case-related events were disclosed or occurred, advancing the timeline by date or same-day events
patterns.domain: Medical or public health case narratives

patterns.name: Temporal classification and event definitions in medical studies
patterns.context: Defines clinical event categories in headings or lists, using criteria such as duration to define events

patterns.name: Clinical course in case diagnosis
patterns.context: Case reports combine examination findings, symptoms, or disease course to infer the cause and progression of an event

patterns.name: Recency of case and literature reports
patterns.context: Introduces reports in prior literature or a rare case recently encountered by the authors, often in the introduction

patterns.name: Complications and repeat surgery in clinical study results
patterns.context: Reports surgical risks, complication rates, and severity after patient follow-up

patterns.name: Definition of nonfatal stroke in a table or list
patterns.context: Lists stroke by event type and describes its ischemic or hemorrhagic origin and neurological symptom criteria

10_1661.description: 激活跨数学公式、体育报道和医学文本；医学段落常涉及随访或病程时间、事件界定、病例与研究结果，但并无单一词汇或领域能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的延迟时间与随访时长
patterns.trigger: “the last follow-up”“mean follow-up of … years”“longest reported period”“very late … occurred 12 years after implantation”
patterns.context: 医学病例或临床研究中描述随访、事件发生距治疗或植入的时间，常见数字、单位及时间关系

patterns.name: 数学公式中的迭代下标与迭代计数
patterns.context: 公式中出现带下标的迭代变量以及表示迭代步数的整数序列

patterns.name: 演化方程中的时间变量与区间
patterns.context: 抽象演化方程以时间变量 t 表示状态变化，并限定在给定区间

patterns.name: 比赛事件按时间推进的叙述
patterns.context: 体育比赛报道依次描述判罚、进球及球员换下等事件，并以经过的分钟衔接

patterns.name: 事件发生日期与调查时间线
patterns.context: 叙述调查或病例相关事件何时披露、发生，并按日期或同日推进时间线
patterns.domain: 医学或公共卫生病例叙述

patterns.name: 医学研究的时间分类与事件定义
patterns.context: 以小标题或条目定义临床事件类别，并用持续时间等标准界定事件
patterns.domain: 医学研究/研究方法或结果表格

patterns.name: 病例诊断过程中的临床病程
patterns.trigger: “during the clinical course”“These findings strongly suggested”
patterns.context: 病例报告结合检查发现、症状或病程推断事件的病因及发生过程

patterns.name: 病例报告与文献报告的新近性
patterns.trigger: “has been reported”“We recently encountered a case”
patterns.context: 介绍既往文献报道或作者近期遇到的罕见病例，常用于引言
patterns.domain: 医学病例报告/论文引言

patterns.name: 临床研究结果中的并发症与再次手术
patterns.trigger: “risk of a second operation”“at least one complication”“serious”
patterns.context: 报告患者随访后的手术风险、并发症比例及严重程度

patterns.name: 表格或列表中的非致死性卒中定义
patterns.context: 按事件类型列出卒中，并说明缺血或出血来源及神经症状条件

en.description: Primarily responds to durations and intervals formed by numerals or quantity words with time units, especially weeks; in legal documents, also covers sentence-initial Approximately…later/after. There is also an independent response to the variable k and its subscripts in mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Duration or interval in weeks
patterns.context: A numeral, quantity word, or qualifier combines with a time unit to form a duration or interval phrase; strong responses often fall on the time unit, especially week(s), but also occur with minutes, months, and days.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, personal accounts, forum posts, medical cases, and general narratives

patterns.name: Sentence-initial approximate time marker
patterns.context: In legal documents, a sentence begins with Approximately to introduce elapsed time, followed by later or after to describe a subsequent event.

patterns.name: Variable or index in mathematical notation
patterns.context: k appears in a mathematical formula with a subscript or as an iteration index; it is triggered only within symbolic expressions and differs from natural-language time phrases.

10_1661.description: 主要响应数词或数量词与时间单位构成的时长、间隔，尤其 weeks；法律文书中还覆盖句首 Approximately…later/after。另有数学公式中变量 k 及其下标的独立响应。

patterns.name: 以“周”为单位的时长或间隔
patterns.context: 数词、数量词或限定语与时间单位组成时长/时间间隔短语；强响应常落在时间单位，尤其 week(s)，但也见于 minutes、months、days。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、个人经历、论坛帖子、医学病例及一般叙述

patterns.name: 句首近似时间标记
patterns.context: 法律文书中，句首以 Approximately 引出经过的时间，再接 later 或 after 描述后续事件。

patterns.name: 数学记号中的变量或指标
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现带下标或作为迭代索引的 k；只在符号表达式内部触发，和自然语言时间短语不同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/物理技术文本

en.description: The main pattern is k as an index or variable in mathematical formulas; other sporadic triggers include webpage code event names, patent component terms, medical terminology, and legal language, which cannot be explained by one specific context. Triggers in paragraph 9 are scattered, with no identifiable pattern.

patterns.name: k indices in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: k in variables, sums, indices, or subscripts/superscripts, often accompanied by numbers, relation symbols, or formula punctuation; mathematical symbols that do not trigger do not form a consistent condition.
patterns.domain: LaTeX formulas in mathematics, physics, and theoretical science

patterns.name: Event names and DOM operations in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript event handlers, on and click form event attributes or names, with functions and DOM element operations nearby.

patterns.name: Component relationships in patent structural descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the locations of parts of mechanical structures such as a cage or pocket and their positional or interference relationships.

patterns.name: Anatomical or lesion terms in gynecological cases
patterns.context: Medical case narratives contain terms for gynecological masses, surgery, and anatomical locations; trigger fragments do not form a clear shared semantic unit.

patterns.name: Court-record language in legal text
patterns.context: Mentions findings that can be made in a record at the start or within a sentence, with references to statutes or judgments.

10_1661.description: 主要模式是数学公式中作为指标或变量的 k；另有网页代码事件名、专利部件词、医学术语及法律用语等零散触发，无法由同一具体语境解释。第9段触发分散，缺少可确认模式。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 k 索引
patterns.context: 变量或求和、指标、上下标中的 k，常伴随数字、关系符或公式标点；未显示为触发的数学符号本身不构成一致条件。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及理论科学的 LaTeX 公式

patterns.name: 代码中的事件名与 DOM 操作
patterns.context: JavaScript 事件处理程序中，on 与 click 构成事件属性或事件名，附近有函数和 DOM 元素操作。

patterns.name: 专利结构描述中的部件关系
patterns.context: 描述 cage、pocket 等机械结构的部位及相互位置或干涉关系。

patterns.name: 妇科病例中的解剖或病变术语
patterns.context: 医学病例叙述中出现妇科肿块、手术及解剖位置等词；触发片段未形成明确的共同语义单元。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的裁判记录用语
patterns.context: 句首或句中谈及记录中可作出的 findings，并引用法规或判决。

en.description: Primarily responds to unit words in time-interval phrases, especially month, week, hour, and minutes; sporadic patterns include mathematical index k, first in programming contexts, the patent distance unit feet, and the medical measurement unit cm.

patterns.name: Conventional time-interval expressions
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on time units and unit words in interval phrases, such as month, months, week, hour, and minutes; the context typically uses after or later to indicate elapsed time since an event, often with a nearby quantity word.
patterns.domain: Narrative writing, including legal narratives, personal accounts, and medical cases

patterns.name: Mathematical iteration index k
patterns.context: The letter k is used as an iteration index in a Newton's method formula and its explanation of iteration values.

patterns.name: HTTP first-save status
patterns.context: In a description of a program issue involving HTTP status code 404 and saving HTML debugging information, first modifies save; activation falls on first.

patterns.name: Distance value
patterns.context: The number 90 and the distance unit feet form a distance expression describing the distance from a line junction to a receiver; strong activation falls on feet.
patterns.domain: Patent technical background, line length and location description

patterns.name: Medical measurement unit cm
patterns.context: cm appears in a numeric measurement of lesion size, preceded by hyphen-separated dimension numbers.

10_1661.description: 主要响应时间间隔短语中的单位词，尤其 month、week、hour、minutes；另有数学索引 k、编程语境中的 first、专利距离单位 feet、医学尺寸单位 cm 等零星模式。

patterns.name: 约定俗成的时间间隔表达
patterns.trigger: “month«10« after»”“« four»3« months»9« later»”“« week»9 after»”“« half»1« an»2« hour»9 later»”“« 50»4« minutes»9« after»”
patterns.context: 激活集中在时间单位及时间间隔短语中的单位词，如 month、months、week、hour、minutes；上下文通常以 after 或 later 表示某事发生后的时长，附近常有数量词。
patterns.domain: 法律叙事、个人叙述及医学病例等叙事文体

patterns.name: 数学迭代索引 k
patterns.context: 字母 k 用作迭代索引，出现在 Newton 方法公式及其迭代取值说明中。

patterns.name: HTTP 首次保存状态
patterns.context: 在描述请求状态码 404、保存 HTML 调试信息的程序问题时，first 修饰 save；激活落在 first。

patterns.name: 距离数值
patterns.context: 数字 90 与距离单位 feet 构成距离表达，描述线路连接点到接收端的距离；高激活落在 feet。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景，线路长度与位置说明

patterns.name: 医学尺寸单位 cm
patterns.context: cm 出现在病灶尺寸的数字度量表达中，前接连字符分隔的尺寸数字。

en.description: Most passages activate near time units and quantities elapsed after an event, especially in legal narratives; other independent patterns include SQL fields and join syntax, mathematical formula variables and subscripts, and centimeter boundary values in radiotherapy.

patterns.name: Numbers/units in time-interval phrases
patterns.context: Narrates the time elapsed after an event; activation concentrates on time units and also occurs near time quantities and punctuation
patterns.domain: Primarily legal judgment narratives, also general narratives; IDs 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9

patterns.name: SQL identifiers and join syntax
patterns.context: In SQL queries, table names, aliases, and field names are adjacent to JOIN/ON conditions; activations fall near field identifiers and operators

patterns.name: Subscript symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Near Greek-letter subscripts, iteration variables, and their values in formulas or mathematical typesetting

patterns.name: Radiotherapy dose and spatial boundary values
patterns.context: Centimeter boundaries and values in descriptions of CTV, lesions, lymph nodes, and irradiation fields

10_1661.concept: 数字及结构化符号邻近特征
10_1661.description: 多数段落在事件后经过的时间单位及数量附近激活，尤其法律叙事；另有 SQL 字段/连接语法、数学公式变量与下标，以及放疗厘米边界数值等独立模式。

patterns.name: 时间间隔词组中的数字/单位
patterns.context: 叙述一段事件发生后经过的时间；激活集中在时间单位词，也出现在时间数量词及标点附近
patterns.domain: 法律判决叙事为主，也见一般叙述；编号1、2、4、5、7、9

patterns.name: SQL 标识符与连接语法
patterns.context: SQL 查询中表名、别名、字段名与 JOIN/ON 条件相邻，激活落在字段标识符及运算符附近

patterns.name: 数学公式中的下标符号
patterns.context: 公式或数学排版中，希腊字母下标、迭代变量及其取值附近
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/物理论文；编号6、10

patterns.name: 放疗剂量与空间边界数值
patterns.context: CTV、病灶、淋巴结及照射范围描述中的厘米边界和数值
patterns.domain: PubMed 临床放射治疗论文；编号8

en.description: Primarily responds to time expressions between events: a number or quantity word paired with a time unit, followed by later, after, thereafter, or similar words to introduce a subsequent event, especially a specific duration. Also responds to the first save and 404 status in a technical Q&A passage.

patterns.name: Event occurring after some time
patterns.context: A legal, medical, or administrative event is given first, followed by a time-interval marker introducing a subsequent event; emphasis falls on the time unit and words such as later/after/thereafter.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal narratives, with some medical cases and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Numerically expressed time interval
patterns.context: A time quantity pairs with units such as months, years, minutes, or weeks, often in a later/after/thereafter phrase; the number or quantity word receives particularly strong activation.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and medical case narratives

patterns.name: First attempt and error status in a technical process
patterns.context: Describes a program flow for saving or requesting HTML; an error occurs on the first save, followed by mention of a later working attempt; activation falls on first and related ordinal/status expressions.

10_1661.description: 主要响应事件间隔的时间表达：数字或数量词与时间单位相连，并由 later、after、thereafter 等引出后续事件，尤其突出具体时间长度。另在一段技术问答中响应首次保存及 404 状态。

patterns.name: 经过一段时间后发生事件
patterns.trigger: “Approximately four months later”, “A year later”, “More than a year thereafter”, “Approximately one month after”, “Approximately half an hour later”, “Approximately 5 minutes after”, “About two months later”, “more than a year after”, “Approximately three weeks after”
patterns.context: 先给出诉讼、医疗或行政事件，再用时间间隔标记后续事件；突出时间单位及 later/after/thereafter 等词。
patterns.domain: 主要为法律叙述，也有医学病例和技术问答

patterns.name: 数字化的时间间隔
patterns.trigger: “four months”, “A year”, “a year”, “one month”, “half an hour”, “5 minutes”, “two months”, “three weeks”
patterns.context: 时间数量与月份、年份、分钟、星期等单位相连，常处于 later/after/thereafter 短语中；数字或数量词获得特别强的激活。
patterns.domain: 法律文书及医学病例叙述

patterns.name: 技术流程中的首次尝试与错误状态
patterns.context: 描述保存或请求 HTML 的程序流程，错误在首次保存时出现，之后提及可工作的后续尝试；激活落在 first 及相关序数/状态表达上。

en.description: Primarily responds to time intervals in narratives, especially “number/quantifier + time unit + later/after,” and also to approximate duration expressions; common in legal factual narratives, also appearing in medical courses. Dates often serve as auxiliary anchors.

patterns.name: Subsequent events after a time interval
patterns.context: A number or quantifier precedes a time unit, with common expressions such as “Approximately/«About»/“some” + duration + “later/after”; the marker usually falls on the duration word, narrating a subsequent event.
patterns.domain: Legal judgment factual narratives and medical case abstracts

patterns.name: Approximate time expressions
patterns.context: Uses approximate or imprecise wording to describe a period of time or event order; these words also activate, but usually less strongly than duration units.

patterns.name: Specific dates and temporal order
patterns.context: Specific calendar dates appear within time-interval narratives, often adjacent to temporal locators such as “on” or “before”; the dates themselves are not the main activation points.

patterns.name: Medical course and subsequent follow-up
patterns.context: A medical case first describes treatment, examination, or symptom changes, then uses elapsed time to introduce the patient’s subsequent visit.

10_1661.description: 主要响应叙事中的时间间隔，尤其是“数字/数量词+时间单位+later/after”，也对近似时长表达有反应；常见于法律事实叙述，亦见医学病程。日期多作辅助定位。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后续事件
patterns.context: 时间单位前有数字或数量词，常见表达为“Approximately/«About»/“some” + 时长 + “later/after”；标记通常落在时长词上，叙述随后发生的事件。
patterns.domain: 法律判决事实叙述及医学病例摘要

patterns.name: 近似时间表达
patterns.context: 用近似或非精确措辞描述一段时间或事件发生的先后；这些词自身也有激活，但强度通常低于时长单位。

patterns.name: 具体日期与时间顺序
patterns.context: 时间间隔叙述中夹有具体日历日期，常与“on”“before”等时间定位词相邻；日期本身并非主要激活点。

patterns.name: 医学病程与后续复诊
patterns.context: 医学病例先描述治疗、检查或症状变化，再以经过的时间引出患者后续就诊。

en.description: All passages contain time-interval expressions: elapsed time quantified in months, weeks, years, days, or minutes, followed by later/after to introduce a subsequent event; common in legal case timelines and also found in medical cases. Dates and legal or medical facts are frequent accompanying contexts.

patterns.name: After a period of time
patterns.context: Time quantifiers (month/months, week(s), year(s), days) combine with after or later, usually linking an earlier event to a subsequent one; activation concentrates around the time quantifier and the subsequent marker.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal judgment narratives, also medical case narratives

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and factual narrative
patterns.context: Judicial decisions recount proceedings, rulings, or case facts; these often occur alongside time-interval narratives, though not all instances are triggered by legal terminology itself.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, litigation, and case background

patterns.name: Progression of time after a medical event
patterns.context: In case reports or medical records, elapsed time introduces subsequent treatment, examination, or clinical developments.
patterns.domain: Medical cases and clinical research texts

patterns.name: Dates alongside time quantifiers
patterns.context: In legal narratives, specific dates often follow or accompany time-interval expressions; dates themselves appear to have weaker activation, with the core still centered on temporal progression.

10_1661.description: 所有段落都出现时间间隔表达：以月、周、年、日或分钟量化经过时间，并用 after/later 引出后续事件；多见于法律案件时间线，也见医学病例。日期及法律、医疗事实是常见伴随语境。

patterns.name: 一段时间后
patterns.trigger: «Approximately« one»2« month»10 after»2；«Approximately« four»3« months»10 later»；«Several»2« months»9 later»；«About« two»2« months»9 later»；«Ten»2« months»9 later»；«Two»2« years»9« later»；«A»2« few»4« weeks»10« after»2；«A»2« year»9 later
patterns.context: 时间量词（month/months、week(s)、year(s)、days）与 after 或 later 连用，通常连接先前事件与后续事件；强度集中在时间量词及其后续标记附近。
patterns.domain: 以法律判决叙事为主，也见医学病例叙事

patterns.name: 法律案件程序与事实叙述
patterns.trigger: «genuine»…«issue» of material fact；«exhaustion requirement»；«petition»；«hearing»；«sentenced»；«the property was sold»
patterns.context: 司法判决中叙述程序、裁决或案件事实；常与时间间隔叙述相邻，但并非所有实例都由法律术语本身触发。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、诉讼及案件事实背景

patterns.name: 医学事件后的时间推进
patterns.trigger: «A»« few»« weeks»…« after»；«Several»« minutes»…« after»；«Two»« years»« later»
patterns.context: 病例或医疗记录中，以经过的时间引出治疗、检查或病情后续。
patterns.domain: 医学病例及临床研究文本

patterns.name: 日期与时间量词并列
patterns.context: 在法律叙述中，具体日期常紧随或伴随时间间隔表达；日期本身似有较弱激活，核心仍偏向时间推进表达。

en.concept: Event Narration After a Time Interval
en.description: Primarily responds to narratives of events occurring after a period of time: time quantities with units such as days, weeks, months, and years, as well as later, after, dates, and nearby punctuation; sporadic medical and legal terms also activate.

patterns.name: After a Period of Time
patterns.context: After narrating an event, a period of time passes before a subsequent event or state is introduced; common formats include a time unit + later/after, as well as «A few weeks after».
patterns.domain: Case timelines in legal rulings; occasional medical case narratives

patterns.name: Quantity and Time Unit
patterns.context: A time-quantity phrase marks the interval between a preceding event and a subsequent event; the quantity itself is sometimes also marked.

patterns.name: Prepositions and Dates in Time Phrases
patterns.context: Adjacent to expressions of time intervals, these anchor the dates on which case events occur; activation also falls on nearby punctuation or date tokens.
patterns.domain: Legal factual narratives organized by date

patterns.name: Other Sporadic Words
patterns.context: These words occur in their respective passages but have no clear, consistent shared context with the recurring time-interval structure across passages.
patterns.domain: Legal facts, medical terminology, and case reports

10_1661.concept: 时间间隔后的事件叙述
10_1661.description: 主要响应经过一段时间后发生事件的叙述：时间数量词与 days、weeks、months、years 等单位，以及 later、after、日期和邻近标点；零散医学、法律词也有激活。

patterns.name: 一段时间后
patterns.context: 在叙述某事件后经过一段时间，再引入后续事件或状态；常见格式为时间单位 + later/after，也有 «A few weeks after»。
patterns.domain: 法律判决中的案件时间线；少量医学病例叙述

patterns.name: 数量词与时间单位
patterns.context: 时间数量短语用于标示后续事件距先前事件的间隔；数量词本身有时也被标记。

patterns.name: 时间短语中的介词和日期
patterns.context: 与时间间隔表达相邻，用于锚定案件事件发生的日期；激活也落在相邻标点或日期 token 上。
patterns.domain: 以日期推进的法律事实叙述

patterns.name: 其他零散词语
patterns.context: 这些词在各自段落中出现，但与跨段反复出现的时间间隔结构没有明显一致的共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 法律事实、医学术语及病例报告

en.concept: Events after a period of time
en.description: All passages contain time intervals expressed by numbers or general quantity words, connecting earlier and later events through later/after or nearby context; days, weeks, and months are common in legal and medical narratives.

patterns.name: Subsequent event after a time interval
patterns.context: An event or time point is stated first, followed by a subsequent event introduced by elapsed time; durations are usually specific numbers, commonly days, weeks, or months.
patterns.domain: Legal judgment narratives and medical case/paper narratives

patterns.name: Time quantifiers in phrases
patterns.context: Specific or general time quantifiers mark the interval between two events; these expressions occur at the start of a sentence or clause and connect the preceding and following narrative.

patterns.name: Numeric markers of time units
patterns.context: A time unit and number jointly express elapsed duration; some examples include “30 months” followed by “after,” or a time quantifier separated from “later.”

10_1661.concept: 经过一段时间后的事件
10_1661.description: 所有片段都出现以数字或概括量词表示的时间间隔，并以 later/after 或邻近上下文连接前后事件；常见 days、weeks、months，见于法律与医学叙事。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后续事件
patterns.trigger: 数字时间单位后接 “later” 或 “after”，尤其是 “weeks/months/days ... later/after”
patterns.context: 先陈述某事件或时间点，再用经过一段时间引出后续事件；时长通常是具体数字，常见 days、weeks、months。
patterns.domain: 法律判决叙事与医学病例/论文叙事

patterns.name: 短语中的时间量词
patterns.trigger: “A few weeks” （[1]）、“A few days” （[4]）、“Four days” （[6]）、“Three days” （[7]）、“Several months” （[8]）、“Ten months” （[9]）、“Two days” （[10]）
patterns.context: 具体或概括的时间量词标记两事件间隔；这些表达处于句首或分句开头，连接前后叙事。

patterns.name: 时间单位的数值标记
patterns.context: 时间单位与数字共同表示经过的时长；个别例子如 “30 months” 后接 “after”，或时间量词与 “later” 分开出现。

en.concept: Event Progression After a Time Interval
en.description: Activations concentrate on expressions that introduce a subsequent event after a period of time, especially combinations of a specific duration with later/after; the style is primarily legal factual narrative, but also includes temporal progression in medical follow-up and technical explanations.

patterns.name: Subsequent Event After a Period of Time
patterns.context: After narrating an earlier event, a time interval introduces an event that occurs later; activation is strongest near the time unit or “later/after”.
patterns.domain: Primarily factual narratives of legal cases; also medical papers and technical Q&A

10_1661.concept: 时间间隔后的事件推进
10_1661.description: 激活集中在跨越一段时间后引出后续事件的表达，尤其是具体时长与 later/after 的组合；文体以法律事实叙述为主，也覆盖医学随访和技术说明中的时间推进。

patterns.name: 一段时间后发生后续事件
patterns.trigger: “weeks/months/days later/after”及时间长度，如 “A few weeks ...”, “Several months ...”, “30 months after”, “Two months later”, “Four days later”, “four months later”, “Nine months later”
patterns.context: 在叙述先前事件后，以时间间隔引出之后发生的事件；时间单位或 “later/after” 附近激活最强。
patterns.domain: 主要为法律案件的事实叙述；也见医学论文和技术问答

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions indicating the duration elapsed after an event, especially combinations of numbers with months/days/weeks/years and after/later; it also responds to link directions containing above in two web-page explanations.

patterns.name: Specific Duration Followed by later/after
patterns.context: A duration number or time unit is followed by later/after, often introducing a subsequent event; especially prominent near the number and time unit.
patterns.domain: Narratives in medical case summaries and legal opinions

patterns.name: Numbers Indicating Elapsed Time
patterns.context: A number indicates the duration elapsed after an event, often co-occurring with after/later; activation falls near the time-quantity expression.

patterns.name: above in Web-Page Directions
patterns.context: In a web-page explanation in an email log, instructs users to click the link above or copy the link.

10_1661.description: 主要响应表示事件后经过时长的表达，尤其数字与 months/days/weeks/years 及 after/later 的组合；另在两段网页说明中响应 above line 的链接指示语。

patterns.name: 具体时间长度加 later/after
patterns.context: 时长数词或时间单位后接 later/after，常引出后续事件；数字和时间单位附近尤其突出
patterns.domain: 医学病例摘要与法律意见书的叙事

patterns.name: 经过时间的数字
patterns.trigger: “30 months”“16 months”“5 years”“four months”“Several months”“Two months”“Three days”“A few weeks”“26 months”
patterns.context: 数字表示事件发生后经过的时长，常与 after/later 同现；强度落在时间数量表达附近
patterns.domain: 医学病例摘要、法律意见书

patterns.name: 网页指示中的 above
patterns.context: 在邮件日志网页说明中，指示用户点击上方链接或复制链接
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的网页/界面说明

en.description: Most passages narrate elapsed time and subsequent events, with strong activation near duration words and later/prior; a recipe example involving “no pockets of flour” is also present, with no clear common trigger between the two.

patterns.name: Delayed-time expressions
patterns.context: A time interval or relative-time word is followed by an event, course of illness, or narrative development; often occurs at the start of a sentence or clause, with activation concentrated around time quantifiers (such as “days,” “minutes,” “months,” “weeks”) and “later/prior.”
patterns.domain: Narrative texts such as medical cases, legal judgments, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Quantity units after a time interval
patterns.context: A numeral and time unit express elapsed duration, especially when followed by “after/later” or a change of events; the first passage’s “one last message” may also relate to a subsequent event after an interval, but is not a standard time quantifier.
patterns.domain: Medical and legal narratives, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Negative quantity phrase in baking instructions
patterns.context: A recipe instruction says not to leave pockets of unmixed flour in the dough; activation falls near “pockets.”

10_1661.description: 多数段落在叙述经过的时间及其后续事件，强激活落在时长词和 later/prior 附近；另有食谱中“no pockets of flour”的孤例，二者缺少明确共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 延迟时间表达
patterns.trigger: “After a short while”“Three days after”“Five minutes later”“Several months later”“A few weeks later”“Two years later”“Six months postoperatively”“Three months prior”
patterns.context: 时间间隔或相对时间词后接事件、病程或叙述进展；常出现在句首或从句中，激活集中在时间量词（如“days”“minutes”“months”“weeks”）及“later/prior”附近。
patterns.domain: 医学病例、法律判决、技术问答等叙述性文本

patterns.name: 时间间隔后的数量单位
patterns.context: 数词和时间单位构成经过时长，尤其是随后出现“after/later”或事件变化；第1段“one last message”也可能与间隔后的后续事件有关，但不是标准时间量词。
patterns.domain: 医学与法律叙述、技术问答

patterns.name: 烘焙步骤中的否定数量搭配
patterns.context: 食谱操作句中，no 后接 pockets，随后说明面团中不应残留面粉团块；触发落在“pockets”附近。

en.description: Most activations occur in time-interval expressions: a number plus months/years/days/weeks, followed by later or after to introduce a subsequent event; also seen in brief waits in program messages and ordinal turns in procedural steps.

patterns.name: Narrative After a Time Interval
patterns.context: After narrating an earlier event, marks the passage of time and moves on to a subsequent event; often formed from a duration and later/after.
patterns.domain: Legal case narratives, medical cases and research reports; also technical explanations

patterns.name: Ordinal Terms Specifying Procedural Steps
patterns.context: An ordinal indicates a particular turn in an operation or procedure, followed by a description of that turn's action or result.

patterns.name: Messages and Brief Waits
patterns.context: Describes the last message appearing after a short wait, linking temporal progression to subsequent output.

10_1661.description: 多数激活出现在时间间隔表达中：数词加 months/years/days/weeks，并以 later 或 after 引出后续事件；另见程序消息的短暂等待和操作步骤的序数轮次。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后续叙述
patterns.trigger: “months”/“years”前有数词，后接“later”，如 “Several months later”“four months later”“Two years later”“Ten months later”；以及 “Three days after”“A few weeks after”“30 months after”
patterns.context: 叙述先前事件后，标记经过一段时间并转述后续事件；常由时间长度与 later/after 构成
patterns.domain: 法律案件叙事、医学病例与研究报告，也见技术说明

patterns.name: 序数词限定事件步骤
patterns.context: 序数词指出操作或程序中的具体轮次，随后描述该轮次的动作或结果

patterns.name: 消息与短暂等待
patterns.context: 描述等待一小段时间后出现最后一条消息，时间推进与后续输出相连
patterns.domain: 技术问答／程序调试叙述

en.description: Primarily sensitive to units of time spans and their quantities, especially numbers preceding “months”; also responds to weaker time expressions such as minute intervals, spans of years, and output after a short wait, in medical, legal, and technical narratives.

patterns.name: Time-Span Phrases
patterns.context: Describes months or years passing after an event; number words usually directly precede a time unit or combine with “later” to form a time expression.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, medical cases, and other narrative texts

patterns.name: Minute Interval
patterns.context: Describes the number of minutes elapsed after a medical procedure or medication; the time quantity is followed by “after” or “later”.

patterns.name: Output After a Brief Wait
patterns.context: After a program or service runs and a brief wait, it prints the last message.

patterns.name: Month as a Date Marker
patterns.context: A month and year jointly mark a date, not an elapsed time span.

patterns.name: Legal Proceedings at a Later Time
patterns.context: Describes a party taking a subsequent action some time after a court ruling or legal proceeding.

10_1661.description: 主要对时间跨度单位及其数量表达敏感，尤以“months”前的数字为突出；也响应分钟间隔、年份跨度及短暂等待后输出等较弱时间表达，并见于医学、法律和技术叙述。

patterns.name: 时间跨度词组
patterns.context: 描述某事件发生后经过数月或数年；数字词通常紧邻时间单位，或与“later”构成时间表达。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、医学病例及其他叙述性文本

patterns.name: 分钟间隔
patterns.context: 描述医疗操作或给药后经过的分钟数；时间量后接“after”或“later”。

patterns.name: 短暂等待后的输出
patterns.context: 程序或服务运行后短暂等待，再打印最后一条消息。

patterns.name: 月份作日期标记
patterns.context: 月份与年份共同标注日期，不是经过的时间跨度。

patterns.name: 较晚时点的法律程序
patterns.context: 描述法院裁定或诉讼程序后，过一段时间当事人采取后续行动。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in expressions of temporal progression or procedural sequences, especially “later/after” with durations such as months, years, and weeks, and ordinals such as first/second/fifth; there are also occasional dates, counts, and passage-specific domain details.

patterns.name: Subsequent Elapsed-Time Interval
patterns.context: After an event, a period of time passes before a follow-up, subsequent event, or result is reported; the duration is often marked by separated tokens.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal rulings, StackExchange narratives

patterns.name: Ordinals and Repeated Operation Numbers
patterns.context: Mentions a particular operation, visit, or attempt in a series, especially when an ordinal is adjacent to the operation.

patterns.name: Temporal Order Words and Time Points
patterns.context: Marks dates, a transition after some time, or an event's conclusion in a narrative or report; duration is not necessarily stated explicitly.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, technical Q&A, legal rulings

patterns.name: Counts and Repeated Treatments/Procedures
patterns.context: A quantity or duration is used to quantify follow-up, a course of treatment, or repeated procedures; sometimes overlaps with temporal ordinal patterns.

patterns.name: General Short-Duration Expressions
patterns.context: Indicates the passage of a short time imprecisely; in passage [3], connects to a subsequent console message, and in passage [8], describes a student gradually fitting into a dojo.

patterns.name: HTTP Status-Code Debugging in Passage [1]
patterns.context: Describes a program-debugging issue in which the first save returns 404 and a later attempt succeeds.

patterns.name: Final Message in Passage [3]
patterns.context: Describes the last message that will be printed to the console after the service runs for a while.

patterns.name: Administrative Appeal and Exhaustion Requirement in Passage [4]
patterns.context: In a legal dispute, introduces a record from months later after reviewing whether an administrative appeal satisfies the exhaustion requirement.

patterns.name: Medical Record Changes Over Time in Passage [5]
patterns.context: Discusses cerebrospinal fluid test results and improvement in the patient's condition, then moves to a date two years later.

patterns.name: Subsequent Litigation in Passage [7]
patterns.context: In a court ruling narrative, states that a party filed a motion one year later.

patterns.name: Martial Arts Learning Experience in Passage [8]
patterns.context: After describing a student putting on a colored belt and feeling integrated into the dojo, continues with events shortly afterward.

patterns.name: Treatment Outcome in Passage [9]
patterns.context: Describes when urine cytology became negative after repeated instillation treatments.

patterns.name: Balloon Dilation Steps in Passage [10]
patterns.context: An interventional procedure record uses the fifth balloon inflation as a temporal point for subsequent narration.

10_1661.description: 激活主要出现在时间推进或操作序列的表述中，尤其是“later/after”搭配月、年、周等时长，以及 first/second/fifth 等序数；另有少量日期、计数及各段领域专属细节。

patterns.name: 后续经过的时间间隔
patterns.trigger: “months … after”“years … later”“year … later”“weeks … after”“time … after”；突出数词与时间单位，如“30 months”“Two years”“One year”“12 weeks”“4 months”“A short time”
patterns.context: 叙述某事件之后经过一段时间，再报告随访、后续事件或结果；时间长度常被分隔的 token 标记
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律判决、StackExchange 叙述

patterns.name: 序数与重复操作的第几次
patterns.trigger: “first … save”“a second follow up visit”“fifth inflation”
patterns.context: 提及一系列操作、访问或尝试中的某一次，尤其是序数与操作相邻

patterns.name: 时间顺序词与时点
patterns.context: 叙事或报告中标出日期、经过一段时间后的转折，或事件收尾；不一定明确给出持续时长
patterns.domain: 医学论文、技术问答、法律判决

patterns.name: 计数与多次治疗/操作
patterns.context: 数量或持续时间用于量化随访、疗程或重复操作；有时与时间序数模式重叠

patterns.name: 一般短时长表达
patterns.context: 非精确地表示经过短暂时间；在段[3]连接后续控制台消息，在段[8]描述学生逐渐融入道场

patterns.name: 段[1]中的 HTTP 状态码调试
patterns.context: 说明首次保存返回 404、后续尝试成功的程序调试问题

patterns.name: 段[3]中的最终消息
patterns.context: 服务运行一段时间后，描述即将输出到控制台的最后一条消息

patterns.name: 段[4]中的行政上诉与耗尽要求
patterns.context: 法律争议中，在审查行政上诉是否满足 exhaustion requirement 后，引出数月后的记录

patterns.name: 段[5]中的病历随时间变化
patterns.context: 先讨论脑脊液检查结果与病情改善，再转到两年后的日期

patterns.name: 段[7]中的诉讼后续
patterns.context: 法院判决叙述中，交代当事人在一年后提出动议

patterns.name: 段[8]中的武道学习经历
patterns.context: 关于学生换上有色腰带、感到融入道场后，继续叙述不久之后的经历

patterns.name: 段[9]中的疗程结局
patterns.trigger: “4 months after the beginning of the therapy”
patterns.context: 描述反复灌注治疗后，尿液细胞学检查转为阴性的时间

patterns.name: 段[10]中的球囊扩张步骤
patterns.context: 介入治疗过程的操作记录，以第五次球囊充气为后续叙述的时间点

en.description: The clearest signals are months and short time/while in time expressions, as well as first indicating the start of a sequence; “no pockets of flour” in a recipe also occurs. Triggers span medical, legal, programming, and everyday narratives, with some co-occurrences or boundaries uncertain.

patterns.name: Time expressions in months
patterns.context: In clinical courses, treatment outcomes, or legal timelines, expresses the number of months elapsed or an event occurring months later.

patterns.name: Short time later
patterns.context: Introduces a subsequent event occurring soon after something; passage 2 also has “a short while” followed by a message being printed.

patterns.name: First item or event after first
patterns.context: Describes the earliest item in a sequence, an event occurring for the first time, or the first delimiter encountered while parsing input. First occurs across contexts, but its syntax and meaning are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Pockets of residue in a mixture
patterns.context: An instruction for mixing dough says not to leave clumps of unmixed flour.

patterns.name: Month suffix within a compound
patterns.context: Passage 1 contains both a calendar month and months indicating a follow-up interval; activation is concentrated on months, though the calendar-month portion also activates.

patterns.name: Other unclear triggers
patterns.context: Some activation positions do not match the time-expression or first patterns; the specific trigger cannot be determined from these excerpts alone.

10_1661.description: 最突出的线索是时间表达中的 months、short time/while，以及表示序列起点的 first；另有食谱中 no pockets of flour。触发跨医学、法律、编程与日常叙述，部分共现或边界不确定。

patterns.name: 月数时间表达
patterns.trigger: 「months」或「months later」前的数字修饰，如「30 months」「Several months」「4 months」「2 months」
patterns.context: 临床过程、治疗结局或法律事件的时间线中，表示经过的月数或事件发生于数月之后。

patterns.name: 短时间后
patterns.trigger: 「A short time after」「After a short while」及其中的「short」「time」「while」
patterns.context: 叙述某事发生后不久出现的后续事件；段2也有「a short while」后接消息打印。

patterns.name: first 后的首项或首次事件
patterns.trigger: 「first」及其相邻对象，如「the first ,」「the first time」「the first save」「the first char」「first colored」「first level」
patterns.context: 描述序列中最早的一项、首次发生的事件，或解析输入时遇到的第一个分隔符。不同语境都出现 first，但句法和含义并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 混合物中的残留口袋
patterns.context: 搅拌面团时要求不要留下未混匀的面粉团块。

patterns.name: 复合词内部的月份词尾
patterns.trigger: 「... and October 2014, showed ... Finally, 30 months after ...」中的「October」及「months」
patterns.context: 段1同时含日期月份和表示随访间隔的 months；突出表现集中在 months，但日期月份部分也有激活。

patterns.name: 其他不明触发
patterns.trigger: 未能从所给片段中可靠确定
patterns.context: 存在与时间表达或 first 模式不一致的激活位置；仅凭这些截取上下文不足以判定其具体触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to time intervals or wait durations (months, minutes, while), and also to order/position expressions such as last and next; other activations include tiny portion, the year-old age format, and a few within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Time Intervals with Units
patterns.context: A time unit or expression follows a number or modifier, often followed by after, later, before, or of; also includes short while describing a wait duration.
patterns.domain: Medical cases, legal facts, technical Q&A, academic legal texts

patterns.name: Ordinal/Position Word last
patterns.context: last modifies an event or object in contexts involving the final message to be printed or the trailing character to be deleted.

patterns.name: next in robots.txt Instructions
patterns.context: next modifies lines, referring to the two lines that immediately follow in configuration instructions; the specific trigger falls within the explanatory instruction phrase.

patterns.name: tiny portion
patterns.context: Describes only a very small portion scrolling along when the screen is scrolled.
patterns.domain: Software bug report or feature description

patterns.name: year in Age Expressions
patterns.context: Connects a number with old to form a patient-age description.

patterns.name: Abbreviated Characters in Program/Legal Titles
patterns.context: Activation falls within words marked as split tokens, specifically Accelerated and PROCEDURAL; there is no clear shared semantic context.
patterns.domain: Software issue descriptions and legal document titles

10_1661.description: 主要响应时间间隔或等待时长表达（months、minutes、while），也响应 last、next 等顺序/位置表达；另有 tiny portion、年龄格式 year-old，以及少量词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 带单位的时间间隔
patterns.trigger: « months»10（[1]）；« minutes»9（[5]、[9]）；« months»9（[7]）；« minutes»9（[8]）；« short»6« while»4（[3]）
patterns.context: 时间单位或时间表达出现在数值、修饰语之后，常接 after、later、before 或 of；也包括描述等待时长的 short while。
patterns.domain: 医学病例、法律事实、技术问答、学术法律文本

patterns.name: 序数/位置词 last
patterns.context: last 修饰某个事件或对象，语境分别涉及最终打印的消息、要删除的末尾字符。

patterns.name: robots.txt 指令中的 next
patterns.context: next 修饰 lines，指向配置说明中紧接着的两行；具体触发落在说明性指令短语中。
patterns.domain: 网页配置文档、代码注释

patterns.name: tiny portion
patterns.context: 描述滚动屏幕时只有很小一部分随之滚动。
patterns.domain: 软件缺陷报告或功能描述

patterns.name: 年龄表达中的 year
patterns.context: 连接数字与 old，组成患者年龄描述。

patterns.name: 程序/法律标题中的缩写字符
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标注的词内部，分别是 Accelerated 和 PROCEDURAL；没有明显共享语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 软件问题描述与法律文书标题

en.concept: Time-Interval Expressions and Local Sequence Words
en.description: Primarily responds to units indicating elapsed time, especially months, often combined with later/after to express event intervals or follow-up timing; it also shows clear activation on next two lines in code comments and last message in technical Q&A.

patterns.name: Time Durations Combined with later/after
patterns.context: A duration unit is followed by later or after, describing elapsed time after an event, examination, or treatment; the time unit itself is the main trigger, while the following preposition varies.
patterns.domain: Legal factual narratives, medical cases and follow-up, technical explanations

patterns.name: Local Trigger for the Time Unit months
patterns.context: months appears as a unit of elapsed time; in several passages it is followed by later/after, and it can also occur in descriptions of treatment timing.

patterns.name: next two lines in robots.txt Comments
patterns.context: A comment directs readers to the next two lines; the preceding text mentions robots.txt usage instructions and disallowing crawlers.
patterns.domain: Configuration file comments in code repositories

patterns.name: Console Message and Output After a Wait
patterns.context: Describes the program outputting its last message to the console after a period of waiting.

patterns.name: One Month Postoperatively in a Medical Course
patterns.context: Uses surgery as a reference point to report the course or complications one month later; unlike longer-duration expressions in other passages, it uses singular month.

patterns.name: Unexplained Number and Month Expressions
patterns.context: A time phrase occurs in a narrative about urinary instillation treatment and urine cytology results; it may relate to the time-interval pattern, but the number and local context differ.

10_1661.concept: 时间间隔表达及局部序列词
10_1661.description: 主要响应表示经过时间的单位，尤其 months，并常与 later/after 构成事件间隔或随访时间；另对代码注释中的 next two lines 和技术问答里的 last message 有明显激活。

patterns.name: 时间长度与 later/after 的搭配
patterns.trigger: « months»9« later»；« months»9« after»；« month»9« after»；« years»9« after»；« minutes»9« later»
patterns.context: 时长单位后接 later 或 after，描述某事件发生、复查或治疗后的经过时间；时间单位本身是主要触发部分，后续介词并不完全固定。
patterns.domain: 法律事实叙述、医学病例与随访、技术说明

patterns.name: 时间单位 months 的局部触发
patterns.context: months 作为经过时间单位出现；在若干段中后接 later/after，也可出现在治疗时间的描述中。

patterns.name: robots.txt 注释中的 next two lines
patterns.context: 注释指示读者查看紧接着的两行，前文提到 robots.txt 的使用说明及禁止爬虫。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的配置文件注释

patterns.name: 控制台消息与等待后输出
patterns.trigger: « one»3« last»6« message»9« will»8« be»5« printed»3
patterns.context: 描述等待一段时间后，程序将输出最后一条消息到控制台。

patterns.name: 医学病程中的术后一个月
patterns.context: 以手术为参照，报告一个月后的病程或并发症；与其他段的长时段表达不同，使用单数 month。

patterns.name: 未解释的数字与月份表达
patterns.context: 时间短语出现在尿路灌注治疗及尿液细胞学检查的结果叙述中；可能与时间间隔模式有关，但数字及局部语境有别。

en.description: In most passages, time units such as months, years, or minutes mark the interval elapsed before or after an event in a narrative, often alongside later/after/before; other patterns include flour pockets in a recipe and next two lines in a robots.txt comment.

patterns.name: Subsequent Event After a Time Interval
patterns.context: A time expression marks the duration elapsed after (or before) an event, treatment, surgery, crime, or accident; numbers and time units often appear separately.
patterns.domain: Medical cases and abstracts, legal rulings, accident narratives, technical Q&A

patterns.name: flour-Related Words in a Recipe
patterns.context: Describes mixing flour into an egg-yolk butter mixture and stirring the dough in a baking step; activation concentrates on “pockets” and “flour”.

patterns.name: robots.txt Comment Instruction
patterns.context: In a robots.txt example, explains that the next two lines disallow all crawlers from accessing the entire site.

10_1661.description: 多数段落在叙事中用月、年或分钟等时间单位标记某事件前后经过的间隔，常伴 later/after/before；另有食谱中的 flour pockets，以及 robots.txt 注释中的 next two lines。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后续事件
patterns.context: 时间表达用于标记某事件、治疗、手术、犯罪或事故之后（或之前）经过的时长；数字与时间单位往往分开出现
patterns.domain: 医学病例与摘要、法律判决、事故叙述、技术问答

patterns.name: 配方中 flour 相关词
patterns.context: 描述把面粉混入蛋黄油混合物、搅拌面团的烘焙步骤；激活集中在“pockets”及“flour”

patterns.name: robots.txt 注释指令
patterns.context: robots.txt 示例中说明接下来两行用于禁止所有爬虫访问整个网站

en.description: Activation concentrates on temporal order and stage expressions: after several months/years, first occurrence, and a few uses of last/next indicating a next step or final occurrence; the time-interval pattern is most prominent.

patterns.name: Numeral with months
patterns.context: Describes elapsed time after an event, often in the structure numeral + time unit + later/after; also includes “4 months after”
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, legal judgments, and procedural narratives

patterns.name: Ordinal first
patterns.context: Describes the first occurrence, input, save, or event; usually occurs near an error or problem description

patterns.name: Directive word in a comment
patterns.context: In a robots.txt example comment, instructs the reader to uncomment to disallow all crawlers

patterns.name: Last in a timing context
patterns.context: After a program runs for a short time, states that it will print one final message

10_1661.description: 激活集中于时间顺序与阶段表达：经过若干月/年后、首次发生，以及少量指示下一步或最终一次的 last/next；时间间隔模式最突出。

patterns.name: 月份数词
patterns.trigger: “months”前面的数词，如 “4 months”“Several months”“30 months”“Two years”（同属时长表达）“Ten months”“four months”；激活峰值多落在数词“months”上
patterns.context: 叙述某事件发生后经过一段时间，常见结构为数词＋时间单位＋later/after；也包括“4 months after”等
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、法律判决与程序叙述

patterns.name: 序数词 first
patterns.trigger: “first”，如 “the first char”“the first time”“the first save”
patterns.context: 描述首次出现、输入、保存或发生的情况；通常与错误或问题叙述相邻

patterns.name: 注释中的指令词
patterns.trigger: “uncomment the next two lines”中的“next two”
patterns.context: robots.txt 示例注释中，指示解除注释以禁止所有爬虫
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与配置文件注释

patterns.name: 计时语境中的 last
patterns.context: 程序运行一小段时间后，说明最终还会打印一条消息

en.description: Primarily responds to months in time-span expressions, especially “months later”; also appears in years/while duration contexts. Other activations include delayed message printing and local activation on the first save in technical Q&A, possibly reflecting weakly related ordinal or temporal-order uses.

patterns.name: Months in Time-Span Expressions
patterns.context: Describes a period of time passing after an event, often to report what happened later; usually a unit or temporal adverbial in a duration expression.
patterns.domain: Event narratives in medical papers and legal rulings (also “short while” in technical Q&A)

patterns.name: Delayed Message Printing
patterns.context: Technical Q&A describes waiting for a while before the console prints the last message; activation concentrates on message and its adjacent future-tense structure.

patterns.name: First Save
patterns.context: Technical Q&A describes always getting a 404 on the first save, with subsequent operations working normally; activation falls on first, with save nearby.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, HTTP request debugging

10_1661.description: 主要响应时间跨度表达中的月份，尤其是“months later”；也见于 years/while 等时长语境。另有技术问答中延迟打印消息及首次保存的局部激活，可能是弱相关的序数或时间顺序用法。

patterns.name: 时间跨度月份词
patterns.context: 在叙述事件之后经过一段时间，常用于交代后来发生的事；多为时长表达中的单位或时间状语。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及法律判决的事件叙述（另见技术问答中的“short while”）

patterns.name: 延迟打印消息
patterns.context: 技术问答中描述等待一段时间后，控制台才打印最后一条消息；激活集中在 message 及其相邻将来时结构。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、程序调试

patterns.name: 首次保存
patterns.context: 技术问答中描述第一次保存时总得到 404，后续操作正常；激活落在 first，且附近有 save。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、HTTP 请求调试

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions describing subsequent events after a period of time, especially several months later; also appears with short intervals, timing around accidents, and ordinal instructions such as “next two lines.”

patterns.name: Events after a time interval
patterns.context: Describes several months passing after an initial event, followed by an outcome, change, or subsequent action; numbers and time units are often near the activation position.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, legal documents, and narrative Q&A

patterns.name: Other narratives following a time interval
patterns.context: Uses a duration or time point to mark event order; need not involve “months,” but still organizes the narrative around time intervals or relative time.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, martial arts accounts, legal accident narratives, and medical cases

patterns.name: Ordinal instruction in a configuration comment
patterns.context: In a robots.txt example comment, tells the reader to uncomment the next line; activation falls near “next.”

10_1661.description: 主要响应表示经过一段时间后（尤其是若干个月后）发生后续事件的时间表达；也见于短暂间隔、事故前后时间及“next two lines”这类序数指令。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后发生的事件
patterns.trigger: “months”前的数字及“months”后的“after”或“later”，如“30 months after”“4 months after”“Several months later”“four months later”“Ten months later”
patterns.context: 在描述某个起始事件之后经过数月，接着叙述结果、变化或后续行动；数字和时间单位常位于激活位置附近。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、法律文书及叙事性问答

patterns.name: 其他时间间隔后的叙事
patterns.trigger: “A short while”“A short time”“Minutes before”“A year later”
patterns.context: 以时长或时间点标记事件的先后顺序；未必涉及“months”，仍以时间间隔或相对时间组织叙事。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、武术经历、事故法律叙述、医学病例

patterns.name: 配置注释中的序数指令
patterns.context: 在 robots.txt 示例注释中，指示读者接下来要取消注释的行；激活落在“next”附近。
patterns.domain: GitHub 技术文档／代码注释

en.description: Most passages activate when send/sending is followed by a recipient or content, covering email, legal instructions, spam, text messages, and access-control signals; there are also three local exceptions: send meaning “take children,” ros in atherosclerotic, and COMM in RECOMMENDED.

patterns.name: send meaning to transmit or mail
patterns.context: send is followed by a recipient or content being sent, often with to; includes infinitive, base, and participle forms.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, email, technical explanations, narrative text

patterns.name: Embedded morphological fragment of send
patterns.context: Occurs in “who send their children to ...”, where send means taking children to school; activation is slightly weaker due to context.

patterns.name: ros substring in a proper noun
patterns.context: Occurs inside the medical term “atherosclerotic disease,” not as an independent sense of sending.

patterns.name: Fragment of an uppercase column label
patterns.context: Occurs in all-uppercase, page-like formatting labels on FreeLaw.

10_2063.description: 多数段落在 send/sending 后接收件人或内容时激活，涵盖邮件、法律指令、垃圾邮件、短信及门禁信号；另有 send 表“送孩子”、atherosclerotic 中的 ros、RECOMMENDED 中的 COMM 两个局部例外。

patterns.name: send 表示发送或寄送
patterns.context: send 后接收件对象或发送内容，常与 to 连用；包括不定式、原形和分词形式。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件、技术说明、叙述性文本

patterns.name: send 的嵌入式形态片段
patterns.context: 出现在“who send their children to ...”中，send 表示送孩子去学校；受上下文影响，激活强度略低。

patterns.name: 专名中的 ros 子串
patterns.context: 出现在医学术语“atherosclerotic disease”内部，并非独立的发送词义。

patterns.name: 大写栏目标签片段
patterns.context: 出现在 FreeLaw 页面式的全大写排版标签中。

en.concept: Sending actions and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: The main pattern is the word form send, appearing in contexts involving sending files, letters, or messages, as well as spam, signals, and network packets. There are also the legal layout term COMM and the substring the within the medical word atherosclerotic.

patterns.name: send followed by an object or destination
patterns.context: send is followed by a person, file, letter, text, message, packet, or signal in different syntactic positions; this pattern occurs across multiple domains.
patterns.domain: Business email, legal documents, cybersecurity, patents, medical texts

patterns.name: Recommended for full-text publication label
patterns.context: Appears in the uppercase layout label «RECOMMENDED FOR FULL-TEXT PUBL» as document classification or layout text.

patterns.name: Substring within a medical term
patterns.context: Activation falls on the split medical word «A»«the»«ros»«clerotic»; this is an internal fragment of atherosclerotic, not an independent article.

10_2063.concept: 发送动作及偶发词片段
10_2063.description: 主模式是词形 send，出现在寄送文件、信件或消息，以及发送垃圾邮件、信号、网络数据包等语境；另有法律版面词 COMM 和医学词 atherosclerotic 内部的 the 子串。

patterns.name: send 后接对象或目的地
patterns.context: send 在不同句法位置中后接人、文件、信件、文本、消息、数据包或信号；此模式跨多个领域出现。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、法律文书、网络安全、专利、医学文本

patterns.name: 推荐全文出版标记
patterns.context: 出现在大写的版面标签 «RECOMMENDED FOR FULL-TEXT PUBL» 中，属于文档分类或排版文本。

patterns.name: 医学术语内部子串
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的医学词 «A»«the»«ros»«clerotic» 中；即 atherosclerotic 的词内片段，而非独立冠词。

en.concept: send word form and fragment matching
en.description: Most passages activate strongly on send/send­ing when it means transmitting content or a signal; objects and domains vary. There are also internal substring overlaps and activation on END in RECOMMENDED-like strings, which cannot reliably be grouped under a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: send: verb of sending/transmitting
patterns.context: The verb send appears in sentences about conveying something to a person, organization, system, or destination; objects include files, letters, spam, packets, text messages, signals, and copies.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, business email, cybersecurity, patents, narrative text

patterns.name: send substring across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on the complete English word send and on internal fragments of other words; this may reflect subword/token fragment overlap and does not establish semantic triggering conditions.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, Hungarian film title lists

patterns.name: Special ending marker
patterns.context: Appears in an uppercase segmented string such as «RE»«COMM»«END»«ED»; unlike ordinary uses of send.
patterns.domain: Formatting or marker strings in legal texts

10_2063.description: 多数段在 send/send­ing 表示传送内容或信号时强激活，宾语和领域多样；另有词内片段重合及 RECOMMENDED 式字符串中的 END 激活，无法可靠归入同一语义规律。

patterns.name: send：发送/传递动词
patterns.context: 动词 send 位于表达把东西传给某人、机构、系统或目的地的句子中；宾语包括文件、信件、垃圾邮件、数据包、文本消息、信号及副本。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、商务邮件、网络安全、专利、叙事文本

patterns.name: 跨词边界的 send 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在英语 send 的完整词形中，也落在其他词的词内片段上；该现象可能反映子词/token 片段重合，不能据此确定其语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、匈牙利语片名列表

patterns.name: 特殊结束标记
patterns.context: 出现在类似 «RE»«COMM»«END»«ED» 的大写分段字符串中；与普通词语 send 的语境不同。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的格式或标记字符串

en.description: Activations are scattered across some proper nouns, medical terms (especially word forms split into multiple parts), official titles, and legal title formatting; the commonality is unclear, and some activations may be related to specific within-word token fragments.

patterns.name: Word form “Montenegrins”
patterns.context: The word is split into multiple subword tokens; one instance is followed immediately by “in Germany”, and the next line repeats the word form followed by “living in”.

patterns.name: Cros- string in a proper noun
patterns.context: The name Crosby’s is followed by “vow: No repeating '13”; activation falls on a token fragment of the name.

patterns.name: Proteinuria word form
patterns.context: The word appears in a medical sentence, followed by a note that the adult also has bisalbuminemia.

patterns.name: Atherosclerosis word form
patterns.context: The disease name occurs in medical contexts such as definitions, precursors, or lower-extremity disease; includes noun and adjective forms.

patterns.name: Official title
patterns.context: Appears as an official title in a parenthetical note about New South Wales.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia political figure or office entries

patterns.name: Plasmid-related word form
patterns.context: The beginning of the phrase Plasmid-associated aggregation.
patterns.domain: PubMed microbiology or molecular biology abstracts

patterns.name: Plasmodium genus name
patterns.context: The complete genus name is followed by berghei, in a context involving mouse infection and Anopheles mosquitoes.

patterns.name: Court of appeals decision formatting
patterns.context: Centered, all-uppercase headings and formatted blank lines in court documents.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court of appeals legal documents

10_2063.description: 激活分散于若干专名、医学术语（尤见多段拆分的词形）、官职及法律标题版式；共同点不明确，部分激活可能与词内特定分词片段有关。

patterns.name: “Montenegrins”词形
patterns.context: 词被拆成多个子词 token；一次紧接“in Germany”，下一行重复词形并接“living in”。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人口或居住地描述

patterns.name: 专名中的 Cros- 字串
patterns.context: 姓名 Crosby’s 后接 “vow: No repeating '13”；激活落在姓名的分词片段上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本，具体文体不明

patterns.name: 蛋白尿词形
patterns.context: 医学句子中出现该词，随后说明成人同时有 bisalbuminemia。

patterns.name: 动脉粥样硬化词形
patterns.context: 该病名出现在定义、前驱因素或下肢疾病等医学语境；包括名词和形容词形式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 医学文本

patterns.name: 官职名称
patterns.context: 作为新南威尔士州括号说明中的官职名称出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 政治人物或职务条目

patterns.name: Plasmid 相关词形
patterns.context: Plasmid-associated aggregation 一词的开头。
patterns.domain: PubMed 微生物或分子生物学摘要

patterns.name: 疟原虫属名
patterns.context: 完整属名后接 berghei，涉及小鼠感染及按蚊。

patterns.name: 法院上诉判决版式
patterns.context: 法院文件中居中、全大写的标题和格式化空白行。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

en.concept: Scientific abstract titles and specialized terminology
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in the titles or opening sentences of scientific abstracts, especially medical and life-science proper terms, research topics, analytical and detection methods, and the period and newline at the end of titles. Locations and title structures also occur.

patterns.name: Period and newline at the end of an abstract title
patterns.context: Activation often spans words in the title and peaks at the period that ends it; the abstract body after the newline usually remains weakly activated.
patterns.domain: Primarily PubMed abstracts; also NIH ExPorter

patterns.name: Medical or biological terminology
patterns.context: Specialized terms and adjacent words in medical and biological titles often activate in clusters, spanning diseases, pathogens, tissues, tests, and clinical cases.
patterns.domain: Medical and life-science abstracts, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Quantitative analysis and detection methods
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving measurement, analysis, detection, or experimental methods; some titles begin directly with an analytical method.

patterns.name: Explicit geographic locations
patterns.context: Titles identify the country or region where the study population or site is located; only two examples appear, so it is unclear whether location itself is a shared trigger.

patterns.name: Topic–result or purpose statements in titles
patterns.context: Titles or opening sentences use structures such as of, for, and as to link a research topic with significance, a prediction target, or a function.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial prepositional phrase
patterns.context: A prepositional phrase introduces the research topic, followed by tools and testing methods; there is only one example, which may be unrelated to the other title activations.

10_2063.concept: 科研摘要标题与专业术语
10_2063.description: 激活主要集中于科研摘要的标题或首句，尤其是医学与生命科学专名、研究主题、分析检测方法，以及标题末尾句点和换行；另见地点和标题句式。

patterns.name: 摘要标题末尾句点及换行
patterns.trigger: 标题或摘要首句末尾的「.»」以及紧随其后的「↵」
patterns.context: 激活常覆盖标题中的词语，并在标题结束的句点处达到高值；换行后摘要正文通常仍有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 以 PubMed 摘要为主，也见 NIH ExPorter

patterns.name: 医学或生物学专业词汇
patterns.context: 医学、生物学标题中的专门术语及其相邻词语常成片激活；覆盖疾病、病原体、组织、检测和临床病例等不同主题。
patterns.domain: 医学与生命科学摘要、研究项目描述

patterns.name: 定量分析与检测方法
patterns.context: 涉及测量、分析、检测或实验方法时出现；有些标题直接以分析方法开头。
patterns.domain: 生物医学及材料/工程研究摘要

patterns.name: 明确地理地点
patterns.context: 标题指出研究对象或研究地点所在国家、地区；目前只见两例，不能确定地点本身是否是共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 流行病学或病例/疾病研究摘要

patterns.name: 标题中的主题—结果或用途表述
patterns.trigger: 「Taxonomic implications of」「prediction of seasonal allergy」「responsible for anion transport」「alternative to mechanical approach」
patterns.context: 标题或首句以 of、for、as 等结构关联研究主题、意义、预测对象或功能。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及科研文本

patterns.name: 句首介词结构
patterns.context: 以介词短语引出研究主题，随后出现工具和测试方法；只有一个例子，可能与其他标题激活无关。

en.concept: Det word onset and document formatting features
en.description: Most passages begin with Det in paper titles, mainly Detection, with one instance of Detailed; the first passage instead responds to spaces, line breaks, and uppercase formatting in a legal document header, a different triggering mechanism.

patterns.name: Detection word onset
patterns.context: “Detection” is split into Det + ection, and the neuron responds strongly to the initial Det; it is often followed by of or and, forming research-title-like phrases.

patterns.name: Detailed word onset
patterns.context: “Detailed” is split into Det + ailed and appears in the title-like phrase “Detailed analysis of the insertion site...”; it may share an onset trigger with Detection, but the following text differs.

patterns.name: Legal document header and formatting
patterns.context: Large spaces and line breaks, an uppercase court-name header, the file marker “FILED”, and the header abbreviation “FE”; activation is distributed over whitespace and formatting structure rather than an obvious Det onset.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court of appeals legal documents

10_2063.concept: Det 词首及文书排版特征
10_2063.description: 多数段落在论文标题中以 Det 起始，主要是 Detection，另有 Detailed；第1段则响应法律文书页眉中的空格、换行和大写排版，触发方式不同。

patterns.name: Detection 词首
patterns.context: “Detection”被拆分为 Det + ection，神经元强烈响应词首 Det；后续多接 of 或 and，形成研究标题式短语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: Detailed 词首
patterns.context: “Detailed”被拆分为 Det + ailed，出现在“Detailed analysis of the insertion site...”这一标题式表达中；可能与 Detection 共享词首触发，但后续词不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: 法律文书页眉与排版
patterns.context: 大段空格及换行、法院名称大写页眉、文件标记“FILED”及页眉缩写“FE”；激活分布在空白和排版结构上，而非明显的 Det 词首。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

en.description: Primarily responds to hyphen-introduced long- compounds, commonly long-term, and also long-baseline and long-range, across physics, life sciences, and medical texts. It also activates strongly on “12” in a mathematical formula, which is difficult to relate to the main pattern.

patterns.name: long hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: The trigger position is often between long- and the following word; following words include “baseline”, “term”, and “range”, with some examples spanning tokens.
patterns.domain: Physics abstracts, life science papers, and medical abstracts/papers

patterns.name: Number 12 in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: Occurs in the formula fragment “- 12 = 3*z.”, with no nearby long- compound.

10_2063.description: 主要响应连字符引出的 long- 复合词，常见 long-term，也包括 long-baseline、long-range；跨物理、生命科学和医学文本。另对数学公式中的“12”有强激活，难与主模式联系。

patterns.name: long 连字符复合词
patterns.trigger: “long” 后接连字符（如 “long-”）并构成复合词
patterns.context: 触发位置多在 long- 与后续词之间；后续词包括 “baseline”“term”“range”，部分例子跨 token。
patterns.domain: 物理学摘要、生命科学论文及医学摘要/论文

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数字 12
patterns.context: 出现在公式片段 “- 12 = 3*z.” 中，附近没有 long- 复合词。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “to” in hyphen-separated phrases in URL slugs, across news, technology, and general webpage titles; also includes a range expression in a code comment and activation on “186” in repeated numbering, the latter two possibly incidental or accompanying features.

patterns.name: Hyphen-separated “to” in URL slugs
patterns.context: Occurs in a URL path or link title as part of a longer hyphen-separated slug; it need not semantically express purpose or direction.
patterns.domain: Web links, news headlines, technical articles, and code-related pages

patterns.name: Loop range in a code comment
patterns.context: A code comment describes traversal from the top of a grid to the end, with a for loop nearby.

patterns.name: High-numbered index in repeated numbered entries
patterns.context: One number fragment in a sequence of repeated entry numbers shows the strongest activation; no obvious to structure is present.

patterns.name: Non-salient or irregular triggers
patterns.context: Activation fragments include sporadic words, URL characters, or repeated entries, making stable conditions difficult to determine from the given text.

10_2063.description: 主要对 URL slug 中连字符分隔词组里的“to”强烈响应，跨新闻、技术与一般网页标题；另有代码注释中的范围表达及重复编号中的“186”激活，后两者可能是伴随或偶发特征。

patterns.name: URL slug中的连字符分词“to”
patterns.trigger: 连字符分隔的子串“-to-”，其中 to 为最高激活；如“to-using”“to-air”“to-atomic”“to-typescript”“to-bottom”“to-kill”“to-process”“to-his”“to-prepare”
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 路径或链接标题中，作为较长连字符分隔 slug 的一部分；不要求语义上表示目的或方向
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻标题、技术文章及代码相关页面

patterns.name: 代码注释中的循环范围
patterns.context: 代码注释描述从网格顶部到末端的遍历，附近有 for 循环

patterns.name: 重复编号条目中的高位序号
patterns.context: 连续重复的条目编号中，某个编号片段出现最强激活；未见明显的 to 结构

patterns.name: 非显著或不规则触发
patterns.trigger: “to”未呈现清晰的连字符 slug 结构；可能包括前导片段“even sink to using chemical weapons”
patterns.context: 激活片段包含零散词语、网址字符或重复条目，难以从给定文本确定稳定条件

en.description: Primarily responds to uppercase or abbreviated identifiers split into subword tokens, especially next to numbers, punctuation, field labels, or title formatting; also covers signature addresses, aligned tables, energy terminology, legal signatures, and encyclopedia links.

patterns.name: Mixed uppercase-letter and number device/system identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers are split into multiple subword tokens; they often occur next to numbers, underscores, colons, or explanatory fields.
patterns.domain: Corporate email, energy/IT status reports, technical Q&A, legal documents, encyclopedia entries; passages 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: All-uppercase headings or table labels
patterns.context: Headings, column names, or labels appear in uppercase or title case, often in report headings after line breaks, tables, or entry structures; no specific topic is required.
patterns.domain: Operations reports, academic/bibliographic text, email, encyclopedias; passages 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10

patterns.name: Email signature and mailing address format
patterns.context: Contact information appears after or at the beginning of the email body, with names, titles, companies, street addresses/PO boxes, and city, state, and ZIP code listed line by line.

patterns.name: Table separators and aligned whitespace
patterns.context: Horizontal lines separate table headers from data columns, while whitespace within rows maintains table alignment.

patterns.name: Energy trading/electricity business terminology
patterns.context: In energy dispatch or market price reports, business fields and price/region constraints are presented as uppercase labels.
patterns.domain: Energy industry email or automatically generated business text; passages 8, 9

patterns.name: Hard drive interface names and version numbers
patterns.context: When discussing storage controller bottlenecks, interface names appear next to generation numbers and transfer rates.

patterns.name: Names and judge signatures in legal decisions
patterns.context: Lawyers’ names appear with uppercase surnames, followed by judicial titles and decision-document formatting.

patterns.name: Numbered entries and external links
patterns.context: Highway numbers appear alongside map website names in encyclopedia references or external links.

patterns.name: Tokenized uppercase forms of specific product/event names
patterns.context: Marketing copy or headlines use all caps, with brand/event names split into multiple subword tokens.
patterns.domain: Promotional headlines in corporate email; passage 6

10_2063.concept: 大写结构化标签与代码
10_2063.description: 主要响应大写或缩写标识符被拆成子词 token，尤其邻接数字、标点、字段标签或标题格式；也覆盖签名地址、对齐表格、能源术语、法律署名和百科链接等结构化文本。

patterns.name: 大写字母与数字混合的设备/系统标识符
patterns.trigger: 如 «AR»«DM»«ORE»、«EB»«34»、«S»«ATA»、«DEF»«ERR»«AL»、«TRANS»«_»«TYPE»、«SC»«_»«ID»、«PO»«LL»«ACK»、«NH» 等分段的大写缩写或代码
patterns.context: 标识符被切分成多个子词 token；常邻接数字、下划线、冒号或其解释性字段。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、能源/IT状态报告、技术问答、法律文书、百科条目；段1、2、3、6、7、8、9、10

patterns.name: 全大写标题或表格标签
patterns.trigger: «SYSTEM»« OUT»«AGES»、«FAC»«ILITY»« OPER»«ATIONS»、«ITAL»«O»« TEST»«A»« S»«KE»«PT»«ISC»«HE»« AN»«T»«IN»«OM»，以及«References»、«External links»
patterns.context: 标题、栏目名或标签以大写、首字母大写形式出现，常见于换行后的报告标题、表格或条目结构；不要求特定主题。
patterns.domain: 运维报告、学术/书目文本、邮件、百科；段2、4、5、6、8、10

patterns.name: 邮件签名与邮寄地址格式
patterns.trigger: «email»、«@»、«com»、«Director Business Development»、«PO Box»、城市/州与邮编
patterns.context: 邮件正文后或开头出现姓名、职务、公司、街道/邮政信箱及城市州邮编等逐行联系信息。

patterns.name: 表格分隔线与对齐空白
patterns.context: 横线用于分隔表头与数据列，且行内空白用于保持表格对齐。

patterns.name: 能源交易/电力业务术语
patterns.trigger: «Energy Import/Export Schedule»、«E PRICE WILL BE»、«COST OF DEFICIT»、«SUB-MARKET LIMITS»
patterns.context: 能源调度或市场价格报告中，业务字段和价格/区域限制以大写标签呈现。
patterns.domain: 能源行业邮件或自动生成的业务文本；段8、9

patterns.name: 硬盘接口名称及版本数字
patterns.context: 讨论存储控制器瓶颈时，接口名称与代际编号、传输速率相邻。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的人名与法官署名
patterns.context: 律师姓名以大写姓氏出现，后接法官职衔及判决文书格式。

patterns.name: 编号与外部链接条目
patterns.context: 百科条目参考资料或外部链接中，公路编号与地图网站名称并列。

patterns.name: 特定商品/活动名称的分词大写形式
patterns.context: 营销文案或标题采用全大写，并将品牌/活动名拆成多个子词 token。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的促销标题；段6

en.description: Activations are distributed across structural boundaries and formatting markers, specific email/configuration/code/patent fields, and also hit “at least” and FARM BUREAU; they span domains, with no single semantic trigger evident.

patterns.name: FARM BUREAU in a legal entity list
patterns.context: Repeated as part of entity names in legal text listing multiple states and organizations.

patterns.name: Line breaks and time zone/schedule configuration fields
patterns.context: In a structured configuration file, field names and values occur next to CRLF line breaks.

patterns.name: At least once in survey statistics
patterns.context: Describes the proportion of a population reporting a behavior during a defined recall period; also includes “at least once a year”.
patterns.domain: Public health/education statistics; product maintenance instructions

patterns.name: Punctuation, spaces, and special formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Activations are scattered near line breaks, punctuation, or formatting separators, with no consistent natural-language semantic context.

patterns.name: License instructions in product or software support emails
patterns.context: Instructs recipients to contact support or call for a new key after the license expires.

patterns.name: Forwarding and urgent/important headings in email subjects
patterns.context: Email header subject lines containing forwarding markers or wording emphasizing urgency or importance.

patterns.name: Embedded firmware macros and hardware identifiers
patterns.context: Chip models, configuration items, and hardware clock parameters occur together in C code comments and macro definitions.

patterns.name: Numbered fields in patent technical text
patterns.context: Explains a servo wedge structure and uses abbreviations, parentheses, and numbered fields to label components.

patterns.name: Organization names and subject fragments in public records
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized organization names or email subject fragments, with no shared semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Sporadic hits unexplained by a unified pattern
